reason: Automates post-turn generation of three critical follow-up prompts and presents them as clickable suggestions that submit through the conversation input.

summaries.zh: 模型回合结束后，本插件将最近三条消息发送给 LLM 生成三个批判性跟进建议，并以可点击气泡显示在输入框上方。
summaries.en: After each model turn, this plugin sends the latest three messages to an LLM to generate three critical follow-up suggestions and displays them as clickable chips above the input box.

capabilities: Sends the last three conversation messages to an LLM after a model turn
Displays suggestions in the conversation composer
Submits a selected suggestion as a user message when clicked
Stores suggestions in a session projection for UI display
